feeds.title: Silhouette America
feeds.description: Silhouette America help you get the most from your Silhouette electronic cutting tool and other Silhouette products. Whether you're a first-time Silhouette user or you're just looking for some inspiration and new ideas, you've come to the right place.

feeds.title: Silhouette School
feeds.description: Silhouette School teaches crafters how to use their Silhouette machines (CAMEO, Portrait, Curio, Mint) thru Silhouette tutorials, books, reviews, & videos.

feeds.title: Swing Design
feeds.description: Find out the latest information on Silhouette Cameo, Cricut, Siser, Oracal, Brother, Graphtec, Stahls' Hotronix, Sawgrass and more. We are the go to destination for vinyl cutting and crafting. Swing Design is the largest seller of Silhouette products including Cameo 3, Software, Accessories, and more.

feeds.title: Lori Whitlock
feeds.description: Lori Whitlock specializes in licensed art in the scrapbooking, digital and crafting industries. She is a product designer for the crafting and fabric industry. This is where you can find video tutorials and assembly instructions for her Silhouette die cutting files and SVG files (used with cutting machines such as the Cricut Explore and Sizzix Eclips).

feeds.title: Rob Ryan » Blog
feeds.description: Rob Ryan is an artist working in the East End of London, widely known for his intricate papercuts which can take anything from 1- 200 hours to make.

feeds.title: Vana Chupp Studio Blog
feeds.description: Vana Chupp Studio is an online boutique specializing in elegant silhouettes. We work with you to design and illustrate the people, pets, and special moments in your life using your photographs.

feeds.title: The Roving Artist
feeds.description: Charles Burns and Michael Herbert work together as 'The Roving Artist' cutting rapid silhouette portraits at all kinds of corporate and private events. They can offer mix-and-mingle silhouette cutting (cutting portraits of the guests with scissors), silhouette workshops, or even a speed-cutting display: cutting portraits of up to 120 guests in a single hour.

feeds.title: SDIVADesigns
feeds.description: Detailed free Silhouette Studio, Cameo, Portrait, Cricut Design Space, Explore, SCAL, Inkscape, Illustrator and Photoshop tutorials for vinyl designs, scrapbooking, home decor, DIY, card making and mixed media projects.

feeds.title: Desert diva
feeds.description: I am a South-African living in the United Arab Emirates (Abu Dhabi) for the last 8 years. Card making helps me cope with being far away from home, and challenges my right brain, since I am a left brained, logical and analytical pharmacist at heart!

feeds.title: Silhouette Secrets+
feeds.description: My name is Elly Mae and I am the owner of Silhouette Secrets+. As an instructor, I teach all levels of Silhouette classes for Portrait, Cameo, and Curio users. My focus is on the personalized instruction of the software and educating users to explore all that can be done in the Silhouette Studio software. I look forward to sharing the love of Silhouette with all of you and welcome you on this journey!

feeds.title: Cutting for Business
feeds.description: Cutting for Business is the original and largest website carrying a lot of information to help you start or grow your Silhouette or Cricut business. The website is dedicated to assisting with Silhouette Portrait, Cameo, Curio, Mint or Cricut Explore, Maker, or Joy along with social media tips and many unique ways.

feeds.title: Suzerspace
feeds.description: Papercrafting has always been Susan's favorite. So much that she ended up in the commercial printing business. Last September she accidentally discovered the world of craft cutting machines and dove in by purchasing a Silhouette Cameo.

feeds.title: JMRush Designs
feeds.description: JMRush Designs is a graphic designer. this blog is about her design ideas and inspiration.

feeds.title: Pretty Paper, Pretty Ribbons
feeds.description: At Pretty Paper, Pretty Ribbons, you can find original cutting files, clip art, and digital papers. Lisa loves using her Silhouette Cameo to create cards and scrapbook pages. She also design cutting files, clip art, and digital papers.

feeds.title: Silhouette Artist Cindi for weddings, love, and beauty tips!
feeds.description: Award winning silhouette artist Cindi Rose gives life tips on beauty, fashion, love, and silhouette art and history. She is the best wedding silhouette artist for your wedding reception, and a life-style coach.

feeds.title: Silhouettes by Cindi
feeds.description: Cindi is a professional fourth generation American fine artist, who has done hand-cut silhouettes for over 35 years, all over the globe. Cindi Rose is a silhouette historian, and speaker, as well as a performance silhouette artist with a historic international speed record.

feeds.title: Silhouette Artist Portrait Cuttings UK
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to enable you to keep track of what I've been up to in the world of silhouette cutting. Hopefully this will demonstrate just how diverse the traditional art form of silhouette cutting has become since it's original purpose as a substitute for the yet to be invented camera.

feeds.title: Jeff Ellison Art
feeds.description: I am an artist who creates custom pieces in multiple media including framed 3-D paper dioramas, hand cut silhouettes, and shaded pencil work.

feeds.title: Silhouette Artist
feeds.description: Hi, I am Welles Tan. I had been a caricaturist for events and parties since 1990. Shadow cutting, also called Silhouette Cutting, Portrait Silhouette Cutting, or Profile Cutting. It is an art that using scissors to cut out a shape of a person's side profile using dark color paper. Usually people will frame it like a photo, put on the desk as a decoration for memories.

feeds.title: Persia Lou » Silhouette Crafts
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Alexis Middleton. I love colour, texture, and pattern with all of my crafty heart. If you are looking for Silhouette craft ideas, you are in the right place! You will find all of my Silhouette craft projects collected right here, and I hope you will find something you like.

feeds.title: Carina Gardner Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Carina Gardner! I'm a fabric and paper designer, Instructor, Mommy, and Crafter. You can find all of my tutorials here!

feeds.title: Happy Crafters Blog
feeds.description: Happy Crafters gives you the tools you need to get inspired and get started. We carry a collection of crafting products and accessories for your next project!

feeds.title: Finding Time To Create
feeds.description: Finding Time To Create is place of instruction and inspiration for a variety of crafts. The Silhouette machines are my go-to creative tools. Crafty Projects and Silhouette Inspiration and Instruction.
